summary: teach now emits its JSON ack when --json is passed; only an explicit --quiet still suppresses it.
reason: teach's --quiet flag defaults to true and gated the JSON ack, so `teach ... --json` produced empty output and failed dogfood json_fidelity. An explicit --json is a request for output; the quiet-by-default background contract now yields to it unless --quiet is passed explicitly (cmd.Flags().Changed guard). Sibling learn commands (playbook amend, teach-playbook, teach-pattern) already emitted acks on asJSON.
validated_outcome: Manual matrix: --json emits ack; --json --quiet silent; bare invocation silent; go test ./internal/cli green; full live dogfood json_fidelity for teach passes.
